title: Input symbol under configuration encoding
statement: Let $A$ be a finite alphabet with decidable equality, let $e$ embed the Booleans into $A$, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a binary word, and let $c$ be a configuration on the input obtained by applying $e$ to each bit of $x$. Applying $e$ to the possibly blank symbol read under the input head of the encoded configuration gives exactly the possibly blank symbol read under the input head of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration over $A$ on the symbolwise image of $x$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine over a finite alphabet $A$ on the symbolwise
embedding of a binary word $x$ under an embedding $e$ of the Booleans into $A$.
Mapping the (possibly blank) input bit scanned by the encoded configuration through
$e$ recovers exactly the (possibly blank) input symbol scanned by $c$.
